races.paceDynamic: Le Coq Hardi will dictate terms from the front with minimal pressure in this moderate-paced beginners chase. The prominent runners Coyote Spirit, Impero, and Londonofficecallin will track without applying serious pressure early. With only one confirmed front runner and several hold-up horses, the pace will be modest through the middle stages before quickening from the last two fences. This setup strongly favours the prominent trackers and forward-going types who can position close enough to strike when the tempo lifts, rather than hold-up horses who may find too much to do from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and Le Coq Hardi weakens from two out
scenarios.body: The prominent runners tracking in second and third can time their challenges perfectly as the leader fades. Coyote Spirit and Impero benefit most from this patient tactical approach with their forward positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Le Coq Hardi maintains stamina and the pace stays slow throughout
scenarios.body: The 135-rated leader uses his class advantage to dictate a tactical race and kick clear when it matters. His higher rating and De Bromhead stable form gives him the edge in a slowly-run contest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the leaders come back significantly
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses can use their fresh finishing kick to sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong. Glen To Glen's low weight and Ephesus benefit from this collapsing pace scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the soft ground or jumping pressure
scenarios.body: A lightly-raced improver or returning horse capitalizes on the favorites' mistakes. Carrigane's unknown form figures or a returning runner benefits from lower expectations.

races.paceDynamic: Venusienne is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start without pace pressure. The prominent horses Kenisa Sport, Love At Sea, Poetic Twist and Maximillian Lady will track behind in a cluster, while the hold-up contingent including Another Blunder, Maybe Someday and Mila Ballerina will need the pace to collapse. With soft going at Kilbeggan's testing 2m3f trip, this measured gallop will suit horses who can sustain their effort rather than those needing a strong pace to aim at. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers who can position close enough to strike when the pace lifts, rather than hold-up horses who need a stronger early gallop.

scenarios.body: Talas Kera or Carmel's Phoenix could benefit from a collapse up front given their hold-up styles. However, this requires the leaders to go faster than seems likely given Venusienne's uncontested position.

races.paceDynamic: Encanto Bruno and Lisnamult Lad will lead from the start, with Ballybow, Jacovec Cavern, Toll Stone and Cobra Queen tracking in the prominent positions. The pace should be genuine but not frantic over this extended trip on yielding-to-soft ground, allowing the field to stay reasonably compact through the middle stages. The strong contingent of hold-up horses including In Excelsis Deo, Ad Caelum, Rexem and Littlebiggie will rely on the race developing into a sprint from the last hurdle. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position handy and have first run on the leaders, as the hold-up horses face a traffic nightmare in a 14-runner field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and prominent horses get first run
scenarios.body: The handy runners can kick clear before the hold-up horses get organised, with positioning proving crucial in the large field. Jacovec Cavern and Cobra Queen are perfectly placed to exploit this scenario with their tactical speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine enough to set up the race for closers
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the strong pace they need and In Excelsis Deo's class tells along with Rexem's proven soft ground form. Traffic will be the key concern but class horses can find gaps.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leaders Battle Home
scenarios.trigger: If the front two get an easy lead and stay there
scenarios.body: Encanto Bruno and Lisnamult Lad control the tempo and prove hard to peg back when the challenges come. Their superior fitness from recent runs gives them the edge in a slog.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the market principals get involved in a pace battle
scenarios.body: The chaos allows a horse like Crossing The Bar or Moonovercloon to pick up the pieces from an impossible position. Fresh legs and a clear run prove decisive.

watchPoints.text: Jacovec Cavern could get perfect trip if settling just behind leaders and avoiding early scrimmaging
In Excelsis Deo needs significant pace help and clear run - watch for early positioning behind leaders
Encanto Bruno's jumping under pressure will determine if he can convert early advantage into victory
Traffic problems inevitable with 14 runners - hold-up horses like Rexem need to avoid getting boxed in
Ballybow represents powerful Elliott yard and drops in class from recent Graded efforts
